317-1475-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

579-3812-6006.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
579-3812-6006.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U} due to Mana Reflection
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-1669-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-1669-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4681-6981-8095.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-2500-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror.
Repeat.

586-864-2292-3125-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-5632.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1594-4399-4770-6720.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4802-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

586-3128-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullport Merchant and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullport Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-7043-7444.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

1486-1753-7014-7223.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.
1486-1753-7014-7223.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5070-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5070-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1017-3532-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

944-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

478-4249-6871.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least five.
478-4249-6871.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color you have devotion to.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

2232-4753-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-4753-6749.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Clever Impersonator enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Clever Impersonator from the battlefield to your hand.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Clever Impersonator from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

678-3641-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-3641-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2793-3921-5089-5902-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

997-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1308-2079-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

4067-6002-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
4067-6002-6071.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vineweft, untapping The Core.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Vineweft by paying {4}{G}, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2292-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
2292-3293-5282.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2896-5145-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding {R}.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat.

2-2034-4094-5554.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2-2034-4094-5554.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-1846-2196-4856.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least three Islands.
1368-1846-2196-4856.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate up to three Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}.
High Tide triggers three times, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Brain Freeze for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, copying Brain Freeze for each spell you've cast before it this turn, with one copy targeting you and all remaining copies targeting any player(s).
Resolve all Brain Freezes, causing you to mill six cards, and each player to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze that targeted them.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to loot twice and untap three Islands.
Repeat.
Once you have milled your entire library, you may use the remaining {U} to cast Brain Freeze repeatedly targeting your opponents.

780-4050-4125.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-4289-4687.notablePrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4289-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1124-2034-2242-2696.description:
Activate Elspeth's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and up to other other creature and/or land you control, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

77-2287-2312-4978.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Fiery Mantle.
When Fiery Mantle leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying two life, targeting any creature you control.
Defiler of Instinct triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1107-2034-2124.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
1107-2034-2124.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

77-2559-4399-4978.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

112-204-776.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least four creatures without summoning sickness.
112-204-776.description:
Activate four creatures you control by tapping them, adding {3}{U} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Clockspinning to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control five or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

2043-4242-4659.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi dies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} Repeat.

396-903-2199.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and either sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out.
If you won the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
If you lost the flip, Karplusan Minotaur's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target of an opponent's choice.
If the opponent chooses you or a creature you control to be dealt damage, Blessed Sanctuary prevents that damage.
Resolve the next Frenetic Efreet ability, flipping a coin and not sacrificing Frenetic Efreet or causing it to phase out due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1371-2088-3752.description:
Cast Theoretical Duplication by paying {2}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing all opponent to copy Theoretical Duplication.
Resolve each Theoretical Duplication, causing all players to create a token of all creatures that enter the battlefield under an opponent's control this turn.
Cast Phage by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Each opponent's Theoretical Duplication triggers.
Resolve the first Theoretical Duplication trigger, causing the opponent to create a token copy of Phage.
The Phage token enters the battlefield, causing its controller to lose the game.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.

618-1496-2645-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Verdant Sun's Avatar with haste.
The token enters gaining you 5 life for each Verdant Sun's Avatar you control, gaining at least 10 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat gaining at least 15 life rather than 10 each cycle.

45-1987-2427-2493.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.

880-3470-4677.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
